import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    pts = [(data[1 + 2*i], data[2 + 2*i]) for i in range(n)]
    # Work in bitsets. Every reachable remaining set is obtained by choosing
    # a pivot and retaining precisely its incomparable points.
    masks = [(1 << n) - 1]
    seen = {(1 << n) - 1}
    idx = 0
    while idx < len(masks):
        s = masks[idx]
        idx += 1
        # Iterate all possible pivots still present.
        t = s
        while t:
            bit = t & -t
            t -= bit
            k = bit.bit_length() - 1
            xk, yk = pts[k]
            retained = bit
            u = s ^ bit
            while u:
                b = u & -u
                u -= b
                j = b.bit_length() - 1
                xj, yj = pts[j]
                if (xj < xk and yj > yk) or (xj > xk and yj < yk):
                    retained |= b
            if retained not in seen:
                seen.add(retained)
                masks.append(retained)
    print(len(seen) % MOD)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
